EchoWear

Overview

EchoWear is a fashion-forward ecommerce brand specializing in sustainable wearable technology. They needed a strong brand identity that reflected innovation, sustainability, and style. The challenge was to create a branding system that resonates with eco-conscious consumers while maintaining a sleek, modern appeal.

The branding solution focused on a minimal yet bold aesthetic, with a distinctive logo, refined typography, and an earthy color palette. Marketing assets, including packaging and digital visuals, reinforced EchoWear’s mission of sustainability and innovation. The result is a brand that stands out in the competitive fashion-tech market while building trust with its audience.

Horizon Atlas

Overview

Horizon Atlas is a travel platform that curates personalized itineraries for modern explorers. The goal was to create a visually immersive and highly functional website that enhances the planning experience. With an emphasis on stunning imagery and intuitive navigation, the website needed to inspire and simplify trip booking.

To achieve this, the design incorporates a seamless search experience, interactive destination guides, and a booking system that feels effortless. A balance of rich media and clean UI ensures users stay engaged while easily accessing essential travel details. The end result is a platform that transforms trip planning into an exciting, stress-free process.

LumeX

Overview

LumeX is a powerful SaaS platform designed to help businesses streamline data management and analytics. The challenge was to create an intuitive dashboard that simplifies complex data, making insights easily accessible for users of all skill levels. With a growing user base, LumeX needed a design that balanced functionality with a clean, modern interface.

The solution was a thoughtfully structured dashboard that prioritizes usability and data visualization. By implementing clear navigation, interactive charts, and a customizable layout, users can quickly access key metrics and take action efficiently. The design system ensures scalability, allowing LumeX to evolve while maintaining a seamless experience.

NeuroSync

Overview

NeuroSync is a healthcare mobile app that helps individuals monitor and manage neurological health. The challenge was to design an interface that simplifies complex medical data while ensuring accessibility for all users, including patients, caregivers, and healthcare professionals.

The solution focused on a patient-centered design approach, featuring clear data visualizations, symptom tracking, and AI-driven insights. By prioritizing accessibility, the app integrates intuitive navigation, large touchpoints, and a calming color scheme to enhance the user experience. NeuroSync empowers users with real-time health insights, bridging the gap between patients and medical professionals.

Overview

PEARL is a campus food ordering platform that connects students with canteen vendors. Students can browse menus, place orders, and track their purchases, while vendors manage their shops, food listings, and incoming orders.

The project brings student ordering and vendor management into one responsive web app. Built with React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB, PEARL supports a practical campus dining experience across desktop and mobile.
